entry_state: Award reserves,earned units,delivered shares and cash rights require separate records. Plan capacity does not supply an individual's terms. Performance multipliers have a threshold jump and a separate negative-return cap;price-window definitions affect the cap. General and CEO agreements preserve different rights after departure,while applicability and delivery dates remain distinct. The two-year compound bond separates liability and equity under supplied classification assumptions. Schedules and initial classification begin on page198 and continue next.
exit_state: Debt payment schedules differ from carrying values and change with fees and day-count conventions. Modification,derecognition and default require separate evidence. Conversion offers,amendments,discharge and delivery may occur on different dates. Cash-flow hedge reserves use cumulative values and release according to the hedged item's treatment,not derivative settlement alone. Fair-value hedge adjustments alter debt and require recalculated interest;benchmark reform has specific conditions. Excluded option time value is introduced on page204,with its method continuing next.

findings.observation: Modification and conversion examples distinguish quantitative tests from qualitative findings,and legal discharge from announcements or administrative delivery. The amendment-date loss and later cash payment are not counted twice.

The hedge sequence teaches cumulative measurement before reserve release. Inventory basis adjustment,interest reclassification and discontinuation produce different equity/earnings effects. General valuation and authority remain separate requirements.
